verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Jules deeply integrates with GitHub (labels, PRs, diffs) and offers a generic API that could theoretically be used to build custom integrations, with one line mentioning Linear as an example of 'tools you use every day' (jules-docs-16). However there is no evidence of an official, documented connector for Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com that lets a PM manage tickets directly — it's only a generic API example, not a shipped integration.
